values.PREREQUISITES: pnpm install has run; packages/db migrations are at 0041
values.TITLE: Export page-size limits
values.ACCEPTANCE: Exports refuse page sizes over 500 with EXPORT_PAGE_TOO_LARGE.
RULINGS: R1 pageSize is an integer 1..500; anything else is refused with EXPORT_PAGE_TOO_LARGE (400), never clamped.
R2 The check runs before the database query.
values.CONTRACTS: exportRows(query) keeps its signature; existing error codes are unchanged.
DONE_MEANS: - No query is issued for a refused request (counted with the query spy).
